description: Admin console strings — Phase 3 (W38–W39). All user-visible text for owner/operator admin screens and components.

notificationCenter.emptyBody: No alerts right now. We'll notify you when something needs attention.

businessProfile.fieldHoursHint: Per-location overrides available in location settings

brandSettings.fieldPrimaryHint: Used in buttons, headers, accent elements
brandSettings.fieldLogoHint: PNG or SVG, min 400 × 400 px, transparent background recommended
brandSettings.displayNameHint: Shown to clients on bookings and receipts

taxSettings.fieldEinHint: Required for 1099-K reporting if gross payments > $600/yr
taxSettings.fieldVatHint: Required if EU VAT-registered; leave blank for US-only operations
taxSettings.fieldShowTaxLine: Show tax line on client receipts
taxSettings.emptyJurisdictions: No tax jurisdictions active. Most US personal-service businesses have no sales-tax obligation.
taxSettings.jurisdictionsFootnote: Services subject to sales tax in CT, HI, NM, SD, WV, and NYC surcharge are detected automatically.
taxSettings.stripeDisconnected: Stripe Tax is not connected. Configure your Stripe account to enable automatic tax calculation.

legalDocuments.headerBody: Upload and manage required compliance documents. Missing documents may restrict payout capabilities.
legalDocuments.docBusinessLicenseDesc: State or local cosmetology or salon business license
legalDocuments.docInsuranceDesc: Current certificate of insurance (general liability, min $1M)
legalDocuments.docServiceAgreementDesc: Terms and conditions shown to clients before first booking
legalDocuments.docPrivacyPolicyDesc: How client data is collected and used. Required for CCPA compliance.
legalDocuments.payoutGateBody: Stripe Connect requires your business license, insurance certificate, and privacy policy before enabling full payout capabilities.

domainSettings.fieldSlugHint: Contact support to change your slug
domainSettings.roadmapTitle: Custom domain support — coming after launch
domainSettings.roadmapBody: Connecting your own domain (e.g. book.yoursalon.com) is on the product roadmap. You'll be notified when this feature is available. No action required now.
domainSettings.embedDescription: Add a booking button to your existing website by pasting this snippet.

notificationPreferences.prefBookingDesc: New bookings, cancellations, and failed scheduling attempts
notificationPreferences.prefPaymentDesc: Successful charges, failed payments, refunds initiated
notificationPreferences.prefAiSafetyDesc: AI moderation flags, blocked content or flagged sessions
notificationPreferences.prefDailyDigestDesc: Bookings, revenue, and alerts for the day

adminFirstRunTour.step1Body: See today's bookings, revenue, and top staff the moment you log in.
adminFirstRunTour.step2Body: Update your legal name, brand colors, tax info, and compliance documents in Settings.
adminFirstRunTour.step3Body: Add staff, set roles, and control schedule access here.
adminFirstRunTour.step4Body: Connect your Stripe account to receive client payments directly to your bank.
adminFirstRunTour.step5Body: Choose which booking, payment, and AI events trigger push or email notifications.
adminFirstRunTour.step6Body: Access runbooks, contact support, and read release notes from the Help menu.

subscriptionPlan.currentPlanNote: You are currently on the {{planName}} plan. Changes take effect immediately with proration.
subscriptionPlan.planStaterTagline: For solo stylists and new studios
subscriptionPlan.planGrowthTagline: For growing salons with multiple staff

invoiceHistory.emptyState: No invoices yet. Your first invoice will appear after your trial period ends.

paymentMethod.updateDescription: Your new card will be charged on the next billing date.
paymentMethod.billingAddressDesc: Must match the address on file with your card issuer.
paymentMethod.stripeSecuredHint: Secured by Stripe. Zarkili never stores your card number.
paymentMethod.successBody: Your new card will be used for the next billing cycle.

cancelSubscription.reasonHeading: Before you go — tell us why
cancelSubscription.reasonBody: Your feedback helps us improve Zarkili for everyone.
cancelSubscription.pauseHeading: Would you like to pause instead?
cancelSubscription.pauseBody: Pause your subscription for up to 3 months — your data and settings are saved. Billing resumes automatically when you un-pause.
cancelSubscription.confirmBody: Your subscription will remain active until {{currentPeriodEnd}}. After that, your account will be deactivated. Client and booking data is retained for 90 days.
cancelSubscription.destructiveWarning: This action cannot be undone. Staff and clients will lose access to Zarkili after {{currentPeriodEnd}}.
cancelSubscription.confirmInputHint: Type the word CANCEL in all caps to proceed
cancelSubscription.cancelledBody: Your subscription is active until {{currentPeriodEnd}}. Thank you for using Zarkili.
cancelSubscription.pausedBody: Your subscription is paused until {{resumeDate}}. Billing will resume automatically.

stripeConnect.preflightBody: Accept client payments and receive payouts directly to your bank account via Stripe. You'll need to complete Stripe's identity verification — takes about 10 minutes.
stripeConnect.checklistIdHint: Driver's license, passport, or state ID
stripeConnect.checklistBankHint: Routing and account number for your business bank
stripeConnect.checklistAddressHint: Must match what's in Business profile settings
stripeConnect.redirectingBody: You'll be redirected to Stripe's secure onboarding page. Return here when complete.
stripeConnect.redirectingNote: Do not close this tab while completing Stripe onboarding.
stripeConnect.pendingBody: Stripe is reviewing your information. This usually takes a few minutes but may take up to 2 business days. We'll notify you when your account is active.
stripeConnect.activeBody: Your Stripe Connect account is active. Client payments will be automatically transferred to your bank account on your payout schedule.
stripeConnect.restrictedBody: Stripe needs more information to activate your account. Please complete the outstanding requirements.

connectHealth.requirementsEmpty: No outstanding requirements. Your account is in good standing.

payoutHistory.instantPayoutsDesc: Available for debit cards (1.5% fee). Funds available within 30 minutes.
payoutHistory.instantPayoutsHint: Requires an eligible debit card on file
payoutHistory.emptyState: No payouts yet. Once your Connect account is active, payouts will appear here.
payoutHistory.connectNotActive: Connect your Stripe account to start receiving payouts.

roleDenied.heading: Access restricted
roleDenied.body: You don't have permission to view this section. Contact your account owner for access.
